node.description: The node's name, as the node service lists it.

command.description: The command's text, run whole by the shell.

shell.description: The shell the agent runs the command in; the node's own where none is named: powershell on a Windows host, linux otherwise.

cwd.description: The folder the command runs in; the agent's own where none is named.

env.description: Variables laid over the agent's environment for this command.

distro.description: The WSL distribution a wsl command runs in; the default one where none is named.
